## Notes

Base thresholds minor 35%, major 20% (4/7 of minor), extreme 5% (1/7 of minor); traits shift the minor threshold, capped 1-50%; mean time between breaks below each threshold about 4 days (minor), 0.8 (major), 0.5 (extreme).
